title: How long is a day on other planets?

lines.speaker: momo
lines.text: Can I ask you something about days on other planets?

lines.speaker: momo
lines.text: Is a day always twenty-four hours?

lines.speaker: ravi
lines.text: Only on Earth! Mars takes twenty-five hours, and Jupiter spins round in just ten.

lines.speaker: ravi
lines.text: Venus! It takes five thousand eight hundred and thirty-two hours to spin round just once. Big word, small idea.
